_comment: Single source of truth for the Express -> FastAPI migration.
A route listed here is served by FastAPI; everything else still goes to Express.
After editing: run `npm run strangler:sync` to regenerate the nginx location
blocks, then `npm run strangler:parity` to prove both backends still agree.
The Vite dev server reads this file directly, so it needs no regeneration.
match: 'exact' -> one URL only; 'prefix' -> that path and everything under it.
samples: extra URLs (with query strings) the parity check should compare.
